Why do women make false rape accusations against men?

The reasons vary wildly. Some want the attention, like the mattress chick. Some want revenge. I'm guessing, but I would say that it's probably most often feelings of shame and regret that the woman deals with by converting herself from a willing participant to a victim. And she tells her friends the new reality story. In years past, this would have simply resulted in cluck-clucking over the poor girl while feeding the underground urban myth of female victimhood.

In the emboldened world of today, the "victim" is persuaded, or even shamed, by her peers into reporting the rape, and the man is immediately taken down. Of course, at some later date, the story falls into pieces, but that's not until after the headlines have been written and a young man's life has been ruined.

EDIT: I'm not quite sure why the OP accumulated the downvoats. This is a legitimate question, and deserves open-air discussion.

Based on only a few stories that I've read, the women who posed as victims were persuaded by their friends into believing that they had been raped and to seek charges (sometimes doing so on their part). The woman who gets pressured into pressing charges may find themselves wanting to drop charges, but police, lawyers, and family/friends will urge them onwards because they believed in the initial lie.
